complete_examples.text: The vehicle includes one car body, two bogies and four wheelsets, and each rigid body has six degrees of freedom (DOFs), i.e., longitudinal-, lateral-, vertical-, yaw-, rolling- and pitch-motion, denoted by x, y, z, w, u and b: The ballastless track system is considered as a spatial composite structure, in which the rail is modeled as Bernoulli-Euler beam, and the track slab and baseplate are modeled by Mindlin plate (Xu and Zhai 2019a) and double-beam elements (Xiang et al. 2008), respectively.
The track structure is composed of two sub-structures: rail and track slab, which are simulated by Timoshenko beam and Mindlin plate respectively.
